2658.event: Watteau Is Born marks the birth of Antoine Watteau in October 1684, in Valenciennes, France. He would become the painter of the fete galante, dreamy scenes of elegant parties in parks and gardens, lovers in silk among the trees, music playing as the light fades. His most famous canvas shows a pilgrimage to the island of love itself. Watteau painted beauty with a thread of sadness running through it, as if he knew the party was already ending. He died at only thirty six, his health broken, but his shimmering world of grace and longing shaped French painting for a century. The parties he painted never quite happened, which is why we still remember them.
2658.announce: A short verse for the painter of parties that never quite happened: Watteau Is Born.
2658.title: Watteau Is Born
2658.piece:
A child of Valenciennes that year,
Watteau, who painted the parties dear:
gallant fetes in the evening air,
lovers who were never quite there.
I wandered through his painted park
and felt the daylight lose its spark.
Silk and music, trees and stone,
beauty touched with the unknown.
He was gone by thirty six, they say,
but the sad sweet parties never went away.
Beautiful, fleeting, slightly sad:
the happiest paintings ever had.
